scientific_limitations: Fixed real dimension d>=3; simple cycles of length m>=4; independent uniform sphere vertices.
Density equality is in L2; no pointwise convergence or dimension-uniform error is asserted.
The sharp TV asymptotic is for cycle length tending to infinity at fixed dimension.
The qubit identification relies on the two-level Bloch sphere, not arbitrary pure-state dimension.
Historical priority relative to general spherical harmonic operator frameworks remains a risk.
title: Sharp asymptotic independence of cyclic spherical overlaps
